Name: Facelift style Yaks
Author: emjess
Description:
[b]Description[/b]
Suuuuper quick recolour of siamece's highland cow sprites I did months ago for Mizu's Yaks. 

Replaces all 3 colours of the yaks and babies via CP.

Literally all I did was was recolour & apply. Um, might be weird if you also use the highland cow sprite as an actual cow, but technically I also changed the horn colour! My plan is to just not use that cow.

[b]Installation instructions[/b]
Download and extract to your mods folder. 

[b]Requirements[/b]
Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/46466]Mizu's Yak[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]! 
(not required) [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9057]Farm Animal Facelift[/url] for matching sheep, cows, etc.

[b]Credits[/b]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/siamece]siamece[/url] - they have very open permissions & these are just straight recolours.
